title: 3D-STORM Protocol for NMDA Receptor Organization in Hippocampal Tissue
author: Ferreira, Linarès-Loyez, et al.

steps.title: Prepare fixation solution
steps.instruction: Mix 3 mL of 16 % PFA–16 % sucrose stock with 12 mL PBS 1×, bring to room temperature before use; this yields 4 % PFA–4 % sucrose fixation solution (Timing 1–2 h).

steps.title: Prepare neurobasal + BSA medium
steps.instruction: For each organotypic slice, combine 100 µL neurobasal medium with BSA to a final concentration of 1 % (w/v); prepare fresh.

steps.title: Prepare PBS‑NH4Cl solution
steps.instruction: Make 150 µL per organotypic slice of PBS 1× containing 50 mM NH4Cl (critical: NH4Cl harmful if swallowed; store at RT up to 6 months).

steps.title: Prepare PBS‑Triton for acute slices
steps.instruction: Prepare 500 µL per acute slice of PBS 1× with 0.3 % Triton (v/v) for permeabilization and washes (critical: Triton toxic; store at RT up to 6 months).

steps.title: Prepare PBS‑Triton‑5% BSA blocking
steps.instruction: Prepare 500 µL per acute slice of PBS 1× with 0.3 % Triton (v/v) and 5 % BSA (w/v); use fresh.

steps.title: Prepare PBS‑Triton‑1% BSA secondary buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare 200–250 µL per acute slice of PBS 1× with 0.3 % Triton (v/v) and 1 % BSA (w/v); use fresh.

steps.title: Prepare PBS‑Triton‑3% BSA‑Gelatin solution
steps.instruction: Prepare 300–500 µL per organotypic slice of PBS 1× with 3 % BSA (w/v), 0.1 % gelatin (v/v, bring gelatin to RT before mixing), and 0.3 % Triton (v/v); use fresh.

steps.title: Prepare switching imaging buffer
steps.instruction: Mix 1 mL glucose stock, 120 µL enzyme stock, and 120 µL MEA stock; adjust pH to 7.8–8.0 if necessary. Use fresh aliquots each imaging session and avoid bubbles.

steps.title: Set up organotypic culture inserts
steps.instruction: Cut FHLC membrane into ~5 mm triangular or rectangular pieces; place 4–6 pieces into each cell‑culture insert positioned in a well of a 6‑well plate containing 1 mL culture medium. Perform at least 2 h before dissection.

steps.title: Dissect hippocampus and slice
steps.instruction: Remove brain from P5‑P7 rat pups, place in a 60 mm Petri dish with 1–2 mL dissection medium, remove brainstem, separate hemispheres, strip meninges, isolate hippocampi, place them side‑by‑side on the tissue‑chopper stage, and cut 350 µm thick slices.

steps.title: Plate organotypic slices
steps.instruction: Aspirate slices with a 1000 µL pipette tip, let rest in a 35 mm dish with 2 mL dissection medium for 25 min. Under a binocular magnifier, separate slices with a spatula, aspirate each slice individually, let it deposit at the tip bottom, and transfer each slice into an individual insert containing culture medium. Avoid expelling a large volume of dissection medium to prevent slice sliding.

steps.title: Incubate organotypic slices
steps.instruction: Place the organotypic slices in a 35 °C, 5 % CO₂ incubator.

steps.title: Change organotypic culture medium
steps.instruction: Replace the culture medium every 2–3 days with fresh pre‑warmed medium.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation (organotypic)
steps.instruction: After 10–12 div, remove slice inserts, dip each slice in 300 µL neurobasal medium + 1 % BSA containing the appropriate primary antibody (dilution per Table 1); incubate 2 h at 34 °C.

steps.title: Wash after primary (organotypic)
steps.instruction: Remove primary antibody solution and incubate slice in 500 µL neurobasal medium + 1 % BSA for 1 h at 34 °C to wash unbound antibodies.

steps.title: Fix organotypic slices
steps.instruction: Transfer each slice to 300–500 µL 4 % PFA + 4 % sucrose; incubate overnight (6–8 h) at 4 °C.

steps.title: Post‑fix washes (organotypic)
steps.instruction: Wash the slice twice with 500 µL PBS per wash for 45 min–1 h at room temperature (20–25 °C).

steps.title: Block organotypic slices
steps.instruction: Incubate the slice with 500 µL PBS + 0.3 % Triton + 3 % BSA + 0.1 % gelatin for 2 h at RT.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation (organotypic)
steps.instruction: Incubate the slice with 300 µL neurobasal medium + 1 % BSA containing the appropriate secondary antibody (dilution per Table 1) for 3 h at RT.

steps.title: Final washes (organotypic)
steps.instruction: Wash the slice in PBS overnight at 4 °C. Image the sample within the following 2–3 days. Do not perform a second fixation step.

steps.title: Prepare pentobarbital/lidocaine mix
steps.instruction: Dilute 0.25 mL EXAGON and 0.5 mL LUROCAINE in 2.6 mL water for injection; use immediately and do not store.

steps.title: Anesthetize animals
steps.instruction: Inject 2 mL of the mixture intraperitoneally into P15‑P35 rats (≈300 g body weight); verify loss of toe‑pinch reflex before proceeding.

steps.title: Perfuse with saline then PFA
steps.instruction: Perfuse transcardially with 0.9 % NaCl followed by 4 % PFA at a flow rate of ~20 mL/min for a 300 g animal.

steps.title: Post‑fix brain and store
steps.instruction: Decapitate, remove the brain, and post‑fix in 4 % PFA for 24 h. Optionally store the brain in PBS at 4 °C until slicing.

steps.title: Vibratome slicing of acute slices
steps.instruction: Cut 120 µm sagittal slices using a vibratome.

steps.title: Store acute slices in PBS
steps.instruction: Place the slices in PBS and keep at 4 °C until staining.

steps.title: Permeabilize acute slices
steps.instruction: Incubate each slice in 500 µL PBS + 0.3 % Triton for 1 h at RT.

steps.title: Block acute slices
steps.instruction: Incubate each slice in 500 µL PBS + 0.3 % Triton + 5 % BSA for 1 h at RT.

steps.title: Primary antibody incubation (acute)
steps.instruction: Incubate each slice in 200–500 µL PBS + 0.3 % Triton + 1 % BSA containing the appropriate primary antibodies (dilution per Table 1) overnight (6–8 h) at 4 °C.

steps.title: Wash after primary (acute)
steps.instruction: Wash the slice three times with 500 µL PBS + 0.3 % Triton + 5 % BSA, 15 min each at RT.

steps.title: Secondary antibody incubation (acute)
steps.instruction: Incubate the slice in 200–500 µL PBS + 0.3 % Triton + 1 % BSA containing the appropriate secondary antibodies (dilution per Table 1) for 1–2 h at RT.

steps.title: Wash after secondary (acute)
steps.instruction: Wash the slice three times with 500 µL PBS + 0.3 % Triton (or PBS alone), 15 min each at RT.

steps.title: Store stained acute slices
steps.instruction: Keep the stained slices in PBS at 4 °C; image within 2–3 days. Do not perform a second fixation step.

steps.title: Perform image reconstruction
steps.instruction: For each frame, subtract background calculated from a time‑sliding average of preceding frames; perform kernel‑based detection above a signal threshold to pre‑localize each molecule; retrieve 3D super‑localization from the SELFI interference pattern using 2D Gaussian fitting (xy) and a lookup table of a 100 nm nano‑bead (z).

steps.title: Filter localizations
steps.instruction: Remove detections with low signal levels or artifacts caused by photon or instrumental noise before reconstructing the super‑localized image.

steps.title: Segment NMDAR clusters with SR‑Tesseler
steps.instruction: Convert filtered localizations to SR‑Tesseler format, export as .txt, import into SR‑Tesseler, create Voronoi polygons, set density factor 2, minimum area 2 × 10⁴ nm² (~140 nm diameter), minimum of 5 localizations, then generate objects. (Other segmentation software may be used.)

steps.title: Define nanodomains and 3D clusterization
steps.instruction: Define nanodomains using: minimal inter‑localization distance 14 nm; maximal distance based on localization precision (≈10 nm xy, 20 nm z) plus antibody size (~5 nm); require at least 3 neighboring localizations and a minimum of 5 points. Perform 3D clusterization accordingly; optionally determine maximal distance via 3D Fourier ring correlation.
